page.layout: One page of text in a single column; margin notes in the right margin (references (a)–(d), Ephes., Cap., Sentiment lett.); running head at top; page number at top right; catchword/signature at foot: "S" and "leges.:" appear as the final line of text with no separate block.

main_text.p: vare poterit, te impugnare gratiam opera-tionemque Dei internam eo ufque, ut & vi-dearis (a) eam chimæris accenfere, & vero (a) Ens-tret p.3:5. affirmare audeas, (b) nullum effe in tota Scri-(b) Ibid. p. 345. & seq. ptura locum, ubi gratia Dei operationem Spiritûs S. internam in anima immediatam-que fignificet: quum tamen etfi nomenclatura a Scripturis abeffet, ipfa res feu operatio Dei in animis interna, in nullo fere capite afferta non occurrat: imo etiam res multis vocibus fæpius eo fenfu (cum ipfo quoque expreffo nomine, ἡ δύναμις ἡ ἐνεργημένη ἐν ὑμῖν,) vel in tribus (c) Epiftolæ ad Ephefios capitibus primis (c) Eph.1: 6,7,8;3, 17,18,19, cap.2:5, 6,7,8,10, 22. Cap. 3:7,16, 17,19,20. reperiatur. Porro obfervabit & unufquif-que te rejicere fenfum fpiritualem Scripturarum, & cum labe originali quæcunque Pelagianifmo & Socinianifmo in his aliifque qui-bufdam opponuntur. Præterea te ubi quam plurima (d) de infpirationibus Sanctorum magis abfurda & temeraria quam cœci cujuf-vis de luce & coloribus judicia velut ex alio protulifti, multa etiam ex libris Scripturæ, Jobi, Pfalmorum, Proverbiorum, totum quoque Ecclefiaften, totumque Canticum Salomonis veluti Spiritu S. indigna traducere: in perfonis vero impugnandis te eos affumere ut plurimum adverfarios qui opinionibus tuis erroneis, maxime vero Pelagianifmo & Socinianifmo, oblectantur; nec magis parcere recentioribus orthodoxis, quam fanctioribus purioris Ecclefiæ Patribus, in primis S. Auguftino, cui præ cæteris es infenfior. In modo autem quo dogmata perfonafque impugnare foles, fequentes videris tibi præfcripfiffe S leges.:

page.notes: Right margin notes: (a) Ens-tret p.3:5; (b) Ibid. p.345 & seq.; (c) Eph.1: 6,7,8;3,17,18,19, cap.2:5, 6,7,8,10,22. Cap. 3:7,16,17,19,20; (d) Sentimenslett. 11, & 12. Marginal reference letters are small and partly garbled in the scan; the printed page's final line "S ... leges.:" is a signature-like mark and is transcribed as printed.
